papers.title_en: Region-Local Copula Evidence Fusion for Heterogeneous Remote Sensing Change Detection
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Ji, Junjun Yin, Jian Yang
papers.evidence: 面向异构多源遥感变化检测的证据融合方法
papers.tldr: 异源遥感变化检测中，超像素Copula模型可提供稳定区域证据，但每区单标签限制混合超像素内部定位。本文提出区域局部Copula证据融合，在保留区域决策结构的同时引入空间变化的局部依赖异常，并用参考排序与上尾门控与连续区域置信度融合。Lake和UK整体优化Kappa达0.78136和0.90817，四折空间验证中无门控参考融合使平均Kappa提升0.00693和0.01793。结果支持区域-局部依赖交互，且标定与门控收益随场景变化。
papers.abstract_en: Superpixel copula models provide stable regional evidence for heterogeneous remote sensing change detection, but a single label per region limits localization within mixed superpixels. This letter develops a region-local copula evidence fusion method that retains the regional decision structure while introducing spatially varying local dependence anomalies. Independently fitted local models characterize departures from unchanged cross-image relationships. Reference ranking and an upper-tail gate transform these anomalies for fusion with continuous regional confidence. We derive the resulting regiondependent local decision threshold and identify a condition under which gating is equivalent to reparameterizing ungated fusion. On Lake and UK, whole-image optimized configurations achieve kappa coefficients of 0.78136 and 0.90817 and improve mixedregion and boundary decisions. Four-fold retrospective spatial validation over ten training subsets confirms complementary local information, with ungated reference fusion increasing mean kappa by 0.00693 and 0.01793. Fixed gating yields a larger UK gain of 0.03353 but only 0.00041 on Lake. These results support regional-local dependence interaction, while showing that calibration and gating have scene-dependent benefits.

papers.title_en: Repair Before You Fuse: Frozen-Host Adaptation for Corrupted-but-Present Sensors
papers.authors: Gia-Huy Thai, Quang-Thinh Ly, Anh-Minh Phan, Tuan Dang
papers.evidence: 多模态融合中受损传感器特征的修复
papers.tldr: 相机-LiDAR检测器在双传感器均存在、同步且已标定时，仍可能继续消费不可靠特征，造成腐蚀场景性能下降。作者提出边界特征修复BFR：冻结宿主检测器，仅在融合边界学习任务监督的残差校正，BFR-C修复相机特征，BFR-L校准LiDAR候选，联合版为BFR-CL，且推理无需干净参考、腐蚀元数据或在线更新。在KITTI-C完整20类腐蚀五级严重度网格上，BFR-C将MVX-Net的RCE从14.07降至11.92，Focals Conv-F从14.29降至11.00；BFR-CL在后者达77.01 AP_cor与10.46 RCE，nuScenes-R上把MoME鲁棒比从80.1提至81.4。该工作为“受损但存在”的传感器提供无需重训部署检测器的即插即用修复方案。
papers.abstract_en: Camera-LiDAR detectors can continue to consume unreliable features even when both sensors remain present, synchronized, and calibrated. We introduce \emph{Boundary Feature Repair} (BFR), a frozen-host adaptation framework that learns task-supervised residual corrections at modality interfaces the detector already consumes. BFR-C repairs each camera feature level read by fusion, whereas BFR-L aligns host-conditioned LiDAR candidates to a selected boundary and routes site-wise innovations relative to the frozen anchor. Their jointly trained composition is BFR-CL. Zero-initialized per-channel scales make every variant an exact detector-level identity before optimization; only the repair modules train, while the encoders, fusion consumer, router, detection head, and host normalization statistics remain fixed. At inference, BFR requires neither clean references, corruption metadata, temporal history, nor online updates. Across the complete 20-corruption, five-severity KITTI-C grid, BFR-C reduces RCE from $14.07$ to $11.92$ on MVX-Net and from $14.29$ to $11.00$ on Focals Conv-F relative to their reproduced frozen baselines. On the latter host, BFR-L raises AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ from $73.65$ to $74.48$, while BFR-CL reaches $77.01$ AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ and $10.46$ RCE with $86.02$ clean AP. On nuScenes-R, BFR-CL raises the reproduced MoME baseline's mAP robustness ratio from $80.1$ to $81.4$. These results establish boundary repair as a targeted retrofit for corrupted-but-present sensing without retraining the deployed detector.
